title: OceanaGold Announces Ausgold Shareholder Approval
summary: /CNW/ -- OceanaGold Corporation (TSX: OGC) (NYSE: OGC) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the shareholders of Ausgold Limited (ASX:...
body_markdown:
VANCOUVER, BC


, Nov. 27, 2026


/CNW/ -- OceanaGold Corporation (TSX:OGC ) (NYSE: OGC) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the shareholders of Ausgold Limited (ASX: AUC) ("Ausgold") have voted in favour of the scheme of arrangement under which OceanaGold will acquire 100% of the issued shares of Ausgold (the "Scheme" or the "Transaction"). The vote took place at the Scheme Meeting held on November 27, 2026.


The resolution to approve the Scheme was passed by 99.40% of the votes cast by Ausgold shareholders. Subject to Court approval, the Transaction is expected to become effective on December 2, 2026, and close on December 11, 2026.


Under the Scheme, Ausgold shareholders will receive 0.03365 common shares of OceanaGold for each share of Ausgold held (the "Scheme Consideration"). Ausgold shareholders had the opportunity to elect to receive the Scheme Consideration value in cash at A$1.36 per Ausgold share, subject to scale-back based on a maximum available cash pool for the Transaction of A$194 million (US$129 million)1. Upon completion of the Transaction, it is expected that Ausgold shareholders will own around 6% to 8% of OceanaGold.


1


Based on an AUD:USD exchange rate of 0.6644 on November 26, 2026.


**About OceanaGold**


OceanaGold is a global intermediate gold and copper producer committed to safely and responsibly maximizing the generation of Free Cash Flow from our operations and delivering strong returns for our shareholders. We have a portfolio of four operating mines: the wholly-owned Haile Gold Mine in the United States of America; the wholly-owned Macraes and Waihi operations in New Zealand; and the 80%-owned Didipio Mine in the Philippines.
